modelDescription: The Ridgeline FFT Titanium Edition combines a precision titanium action with our signature carbon fiber barrel for an exceptionally lightweight rifle. The firearm features a titanium side baffle brake, spiral fluted bolt, and an FFT Sporter stock with a satin metallic gray accent finish. The Ridgeline FFT Titanium Edition weighs in starting at 4.8 pounds and is backed by the Christensen Arms Sub-MOA Guarantee.
